text: Campaign Update April 9, 2026 Lucas Hewitt Announces No-Party Campaign for Iowa House District 61 Waterloo-born application developer launches campaign for Iowa House District 61, pledging nonpartisan decision-making, transparent communication, and responsive representation.

Campaign Update October 2, 2026 Lucas Hewitt Earns Endorsements from Republican Supervisor and Forward Party Black Hawk County Supervisor Justin Brandt, a Republican, and the Young Forwardists Committee of the Forward Party have endorsed Lucas Hewitt, the no party candidate for Iowa House District 61.
In the News August 17, 2026 Talking With the Waterloo Rotary Club Lucas spoke to the Waterloo Rotary Club about running without a party, and Cedar Valley Now covered the talk with photos and audio.

In the News September 28, 2026 My Answers to KCRG's Election Q&A KCRG-TV9 asked every candidate for state office in eastern Iowa the same seven questions. Lucas's answers are now published in their voter guide.
